d61kgg.subject: Aoraki / Mount Cook under the Milky Way, indigo-violet night sky

ai_review.visual_assessment: photographic appearance (star field with slight trailing, sensor noise in the foreground shadows); provenance is not proof of capture method
ai_review.inspected: full-resolution original, 16:9, 21:9 and 9:16 centre-fill views, native-pixel crops of the centre and bottom; see full_resolution_review

full_resolution_review.notes: Exact 16:9, JPEG q99, 3840x2160. Indigo-violet night sky with the Milky Way and a snow-lit central peak: the closest photographic match to Layan's indigo palette. The peak sits at the centre, so 21:9 (2560x1080) and 9:16 (1080x1920) centre-fill both keep it with the Milky Way above. The bottom fifth is near-black foreground, which keeps light panel text readable on every edge: minimum bar-text contrast 7.12:1 across four viewports and all four edges (the replaced pick dropped to 4.01:1 on portrait side edges). Star points show slight trailing and fine noise at 1:1.

crops_checked.21:9: centre-fill 2560x1080: peak, ridge and Milky Way band kept
crops_checked.9:16: centre-fill 1080x1920: peak centred under the Milky Way

fresh_detail_check.note: first-look and fresh responses are the same fetch for this image (it was found and downloaded in one session)

full_resolution_review.provenance_limit: visual photographic assessment and current provider tags only; original authorship/licence/capture method remain unverified

full_resolution_review.notes: Exact 16:9, JPEG, 5120x2880. Replaces p8kyvm, whose ultrawide crop clipped the tree crown. The hill, upper chapel, fog bank and sunlit ridge sit near the centre, so the 21:9 centre-fill (2560x1080) keeps all of them and the 9:16 centre-fill (1080x1920) keeps the upper chapel, the hill and the lower red church. Clean detail at 1:1. Bright blue sky and white fog above, deep shadow grass in the bottom fifth, so a panel on the bottom edge sits over near-black pixels (4.4-4.6:1 for the light bar text).

plasma-breeze.rationale: Selected from live SFW photography search results to suit the Breeze blue/violet palette. The first light pick (57o619) was already curated for nextkde and was replaced to keep images distinct.

dark.rationale: Blue-hour glacial lake under a violet-pink sky: the closest photographic match to Breeze's violet-blue default wallpaper; no desktop widgets, so no placement constraints beyond the bottom panel.

light.rationale: Calm pastel lilac-blue dusk with snow-white peaks: the same cool violet-blue family as Breeze's default wallpaper without a saturated sunset. A dusk image, so light-mode contrast comes from the opaque Breeze surfaces, not the photo.

plasma-breeze.placement: Centre-fill. Any panel edge sits over dark water/sky (dark) or pastel sky/near-black spruce (light). 21:9 and 9:16 centre-fill checked.
plasma-breeze.crop_policy: keep original aspect; centre-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

plasma-layan.rationale: Selected from live SFW photography search results to suit the Layan indigo/violet palette; the first dark pick (gpjk37) and the first light pick (p8kyvm) were replaced after crop and contrast review.

dark.rationale: Indigo-violet Milky Way over Aoraki: the same hue family as Layan's #5657f5 accent and #31313a surfaces, with a centred peak that survives ultrawide and portrait centre-fill and a dark foreground that keeps the translucent panel text above 7:1 on every edge. Replaces a sunset-heather pick whose portrait side edges fell to 4.0:1.

light.rationale: Bright sunrise sky and white fog over a hilltop chapel: a light, airy photograph whose subject stays centred in ultrawide and portrait crops. Replaces the earlier misty-heather pick, whose ultrawide crop clipped the tree.

plasma-layan.placement: Centre-fill. Dark: the peak and Milky Way sit near the centre, foreground near-black at every edge. Light: hill and chapels centred, bottom fifth near-black grass. Ultrawide and portrait centre-fill checked for both.
plasma-layan.crop_policy: keep original aspect; centre-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

plasma-breeze:light.assessment: NOT chosen. A bright daylight alternative to the dusk pick gwwre3: blue sky, white clouds and a symmetric lake reflection (Picos de Europa, aerial). Ultrawide 21:9 centre-fill keeps the ridge and reflection. In portrait 9:16 centre-fill the main peak sits on the right edge and is half cut, so it fails the no-visible-clipping bar for a default. The file is only 1.4 MB for 5280x2970 (JPEG q75): water and foliage look smoothed at 1:1. Source link is a reddit r/EarthPorn post (unopened, unverified); no photography tag from the provider.
